summary: Backend-only test of server-usage metrics (server_metrics.py middleware, WS counters, 15s Mongo flush) and the new admin section 'Utilisation du serveur'. New pytest file test_server_metrics.py: 14/14 passed. HTTP traffic (presence pulse x3, leaderboard x2, friends x2, solo) and WS traffic (connexion, ping x2, pass action) showed up in Mongo 'server_metrics' and in the 60 min and 24 h admin tables after a 17s wait, with Joueurs >= 1 and correct per-user attribution. /api/admin is not counted. Cards and the composition table render, an invalid key returns 403, and the regression sections are present. Regression: test_origin_field.py + test_admin_stats.py 19/19 passed; auth/me, matchmaking join/status/leave and CORS preflight return 200 through the middleware. No new backend errors since the last reload. The '$size must be an array, null' traceback in backend.err.log is from before the last restart (old code) and does not reproduce.

minor.issue: Metric type is f"ws: {msg.get('action')}", taken straight from the client, so it can grow without limit. Confirmed: sending actions 'TEST_xxx_0..4' and {'x':1} created 6 new server_metrics types that showed up on the dashboard (probe docs deleted afterwards). A buggy or malicious client could flood the collection and the admin tables. Fix: whitelist known actions (bid, pass, capot, contre, surcontre, decline_surcontre, play, ready, pause_*, resume, leave, chat) and map everything else to 'ws: autre'.

There is no flush on shutdown and the batch is dropped if bulk_write raises. Each backend restart or deploy (and every uvicorn --reload in preview, which the WatchFiles log showed) loses up to 15s of buffered events. Fix: call flush(db) in the shutdown handler before client.close(), and merge the batch back into _pending on failure.

Évts/joueur/min = n / player-minutes, but n includes unauthenticated requests (login/register, 401s) and player-minutes only counts attributed users. This inflates the figure for 'compte' (18.88 seen) and similar types. Fix: count attributed events separately (e.g. an n_auth field) and divide that instead.

The initial state sent on connect goes through _send() directly, so it is not counted as 'ws: état envoyé'. Only broadcast() is counted. A small undercount of states sent; document it or record it in connect too.

action_items: Whitelist WS action names in the metrics record (server.py ws_game) so client strings can't create unlimited metric types
Flush server_metrics in the shutdown handler, and keep or merge the batch when bulk_write fails
Optional: base Évts/joueur/min on attributed events only; count the initial connect state as 'ws: état envoyé'
critical_code_review_comments: The middleware does not record when call_next raises (unhandled 500s are not counted). Acceptable, but those are the events most worth seeing.
_token_users is never invalidated on logout. Harmless for metrics, it only affects attribution.
server.py is 1008 lines (>700); consider splitting ws/matchmaking routes into modules.
seed_data_creation: No seed data. Created solo games for tester1, then marked them finished. Probe junk metric docs were deleted by _id.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Metrics flush every 15s, so wait >=17s. Editing files under /app/backend (including tests/) triggers a uvicorn reload that drops the unflushed metric buffer; create test files first and wait about 5s before generating traffic. Run with: pytest tests/test_server_metrics.py -v.
